comment: Source read at commit 5458029, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.0. TWO THINGS A READER SHOULD KNOW AND CANNOT SEE. The gate is tested with '(Triggered[c] == 10)' in every stage of Advance() and in CheckResetA/CheckResetB, so only a gate of exactly 10V starts or holds an envelope; the range field says 'high above 1V' because the field has no spelling for an equality test, and the line itself gives the real rule. And the eight stage-time parameters are configured with ranges up to 3 (attack and decay) and 5 (release) at ENVELOOPER.cpp:341-356, but CollectSignals clamps knob plus CV to 0 and 1 at lines 410-417, so everything above one second is clamped away. The panel is lettered NVLOP3HR.
